events.title: Streetwise Talk @ Aeronaut
events.description: Streetwise is monthly speaker series focused on sharing wisdom along the path to complete streets. Third Wednesday of every month, 6:30 to 7:30 PM, live at Aeronaut Brewery. This talk will be shared by Boston Cafe Biker’s very own Aman Shankardass and Chris Armstrong!

events.title: Tour de Streets
events.location: Livable Streets Alliance, 100 Sidney St, Cambridge, MA
events.description:
Join us for Tour de Streets!
Tour de Streets is an annual fundraising event, featuring a walk, bike ride, and a celebration with free food, drinks, + activities provided by local vendors!

To ride with Boston Cafe Bikers you must be registered (it’s free!) so use the link above to sign up

The bike ride is 2 hours long, ~12 miles starting at 10:15: A leisurely ride for people of all abilities. Includes riding along the Charles River and on new bicycle infrastructure around Boston, Cambridge ,and Somerville.

Date: Saturday October 24  10:30 AM - 2:30 PM
Location: LivableStreets Office, 100 Sidney Street, Cambridge 02139 (near Central Square).

This is a great opportunity to connect with partners and friends as we celebrate LivableStreets’ accomplishments and ensure we have the resources to fund our work in the coming years.

events.title: A Nightmare on Cedar Street II
events.location: 204 Cedar St, 204 Cedar St Apts 2 & 3, Somerville, MA
events.description:
Want to come to the spookiest event in town??

You are officially invited to our halloween
party jointly hosted by the newest residents of 204 Cedar St. Once again, we’re pulling out all the stops to create the Halloween party of our dreams!!

The party will be between the second and third floors and front balconies are open. Bring your beautiful faces and best costumes. Costumes are REQUIRED!! Pls do not play with us!

+1s, +2s, and +3s are welcomed but let us know if it's more than that

Can't wait to see you there!!
